instruction: I need quick access to terminal menus. Configure the terminal to always show the menubar by default permanently, so it appears in all new terminals even after reboot.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'alt', 't'); time.sleep(1); pyautogui.write('gsettings get org.gnome.Terminal.Legacy.Settings default-show-menubar'); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.press('enter')
